claims.claim: Submission adds zero new test files or test cases, so the Definition of Done (each of S1–S21 mapped to a passing test) is not met.
claims.accuracy_evidence: BASE PATCH changes only eight source files (table.py, time/core.py, formats.py, time/utils.py, bls/core.py, lombscargle/core.py, multiband/core.py, function_helpers.py). It adds or changes no test file.
claims.addressed_evidence: X adds test_check_leapsec.py, time/tests/test_utils.py, two test_core.py files, and new tests in test_table.py, test_bls.py and test_functions.py. Y changes only source files.

claims.claim: has_units has no direct tests for Quantity (True), plain array (False), None (False), or a non-Quantity object with a unit attribute (S4).
claims.accuracy_evidence: BASE PATCH adds has_units in lombscargle/core.py but no test for it. X's diff shows test_bls.py only imports has_units.
claims.addressed_evidence: X's new lombscargle/tests/test_core.py tests all four cases, including a NotAQuantity class with a unit attribute. Y has no tests.

claims.claim: _check_leapsec is untested: single call, reentrant same-thread call, already-DONE short-circuit, and 4-thread concurrency with a DONE-at-return check (S5/S11/S12/S17).
claims.accuracy_evidence: BASE PATCH adds _check_leapsec in time/core.py with no accompanying test. No referenced test calls _check_leapsec.
claims.addressed_evidence: X's test_check_leapsec.py covers S5, S12, S11 (reentrant double) and S17 (4 Event-gated threads, DONE at return). Y has no tests.

claims.claim: quantity_day_frac lacks an n=1..1000 sweep, the spec's two-argument value pairs, a fallback stand-in, and array-valued two-argument tests (S1/S2/S7/S8).
claims.accuracy_evidence: BASE PATCH adds quantity_day_frac in time/utils.py with no test. The referenced test_valid_quantity_input uses only hand-picked values and never sweeps n.
claims.addressed_evidence: X's new time/tests/test_utils.py has the sweep over range(1,1001), S2a/S2b pairs, a _FakeQuantity fallback test and an array two-argument test. Y has no tests.

claims.claim: Nothing calls Table.__array__() directly to check the mask is dropped; np.array-based tests would miss a regression (S13).
claims.accuracy_evidence: BASE PATCH adds Table.__array__ that returns out.data but adds no test asserting it is not a MaskedArray. The test_convert_numpy_array source was not found.
claims.addressed_evidence: X adds test_array_dunder_drops_mask, which asserts isMaskedArray(as_array()) and not isMaskedArray(__array__()). Y has no tests.

claims.claim: lombscargle_multiband has no tests (the tests dir holds only __init__.py), so the restored get_unit/strip_units are never exercised (S21).
claims.accuracy_evidence: BASE PATCH adds get_unit/strip_units to multiband/core.py but no test file. X creates multiband tests/test_core.py as a new file.
claims.addressed_evidence: X's new multiband tests/test_core.py tests get_unit on a Quantity and a plain array, and strip_units with None, one argument and several. Y has no tests.

claims.claim: validate_unit_consistency needs direct tests for the unit-forwarding case and the dimensionless-stripping case (S20).
claims.accuracy_evidence: BASE PATCH only fixes the has_units import in bls/core.py and adds no test of validate_unit_consistency.
claims.addressed_evidence: X adds test_validate_unit_consistency_forwards_reference_unit and test_validate_unit_consistency_strips_dimensionless_input to test_bls.py. Y has no tests.
